I, Nalaka Jude Harin Fernando, Minister of Tourism and Lands, do hereby declare, under Sub-section (1) of Section 5 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the Lands, described below are needed for a public purpose and will be acquired under the provisions of that Act.

All of the land allotments described below, including their names, and extent, are depicted in the advance tracing No. GA/AKM/2021/249 dated 11.07.2022, prepared by the Surveyor General and situated in the Village of Walahanduwa in No. 134 D, Bambaragoda Grama Niladhari Division, in the Akmeemana Divisional Secretary's Division in Galle District of the Southern Province and bounded;

01. Lot 'A' – Walahanduwawatta – Extent: 1.5100 Hectares North: Walahanduwawatta calimed by the Land Reform Commission; East: Pradeshiya Sabha Road; South: Lot Nos. 18, 17, 16, 15, 14, 13, 12, 11, 10, 9, 8, 7, 6, 5, 4, 3, 2 and 1 depicted in the P. P. GA. 3825 and Pradeshiya Sabha
Road; West: Lot Nos. 14, 13, 12, 11, 10, 9, 8, 7, 6, 5, 4, 3, 2 and 1 depicted in the P. P. G. A. 3825, Pradeshiya Sabha Road and Walahanduwawatta claimed by the Land Reform Commission.

02. Lot 'B' – Walahanduwawatta – Extent: 0.8911 Hectare North: Walahanduwawatta claimed by the Land Reform Commission; East: Walahanduwawatta claimed by the Land Reform Commission and Pradeshiya Sabha Road; South: Pradeshiya Sabha Road; West: Pradeshiya Sabha Road and Walahanduwawatta claimed by the Land Reform Commission.
Harin Fernando, Minister of Tourism and Lands.
My No. : 4-3/17/2020/D/185.Ministry of Tourism and Lands,"Mihikatha Medura", No.1200, Rajamalwatta Road,Battaramulla,19th February 2024.
